title: Read
description: Output of `rule read`. With a `<rulePathInModel>` argument: one stored rule's condition read back — `converted` true = rulekit fully modeled every construct (an ordinary AST, ready for explain/diff); false = a tolerant Opaque passthrough preserving the kernel's text verbatim — plus the rule's stored `messages` (locale → text, raw/uninterpolated; native-capable). With NO argument: a lean name-index — `rules` (every rule's full name) + `count` — the navigation handle to then read one. (The whole-model read of every rule and computation is `model read`.)

converted.description: (one rule) true = Converted (full rulekit AST); false = Opaque (verbatim passthrough)

condition.description: (one rule, Converted) the rendered DSL of the condition

canonicalText.description: (one rule, Opaque) the raw kernel condition text, preserved verbatim

messages.description: (one rule) the rule's stored error messages — raw + uninterpolated (locale → text), native-capable (no runtime eval); for auditing wording / message length / locale coverage

locale.description: the DM-JSON locale code, e.g. en_US

text.description: the stored message text (NOT interpolated — the runtime, value-substituted message is `model eval`)

rules.description: (name-index) every rule's full name, in document order — pass one back as `rule read <name>` to read its condition
